prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though home notification was underpredicted (+0.6% predicted vs +3.5% measured).
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info changes across 4 tests.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful in 1 winning test, though no clear effect was seen in 3 other tests.
Finish new_screen changes showed no clear effect or hurt performance across 2 tests.
Adoption layout changes yielded no clear positive effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path changes, finish layout and copy changes, home notification, sign_in redesign, and adoption redesign or new_screen changes (fewer than 2 agreeing tests).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -6.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -6.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 82.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Changes:
0: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Character Choice Carousel Layout: Switch the friend selection screen to a carousel layout that displays desktop companion character options one by one. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% with a high median duration of 89s, showing users struggle to make a selection in the standard view.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Placement Instructions Wait Info: Update the waiting screen with clear instructions detailing where the pet will launch on the desktop alongside a progress bar. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app fails to open, while mean home wait time is over 38 minutes.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Primer Welcome Screen Redesign: Redesign the final welcome screen into a split layout that highlights desktop tray controls, visibility toggles, and pet interaction keys. (why: 7 support emails mentioned confusion regarding controlling/hiding pets or desktop feature misbehavior post-onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Retention Safeguard Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that their chosen pet data is preserved upon login. (why: 8 support emails (the largest single category) reported pets missing or reset after signing in.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Full Bleed Preview Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen using a full bleed layout to immediately showcase pet desktop integration. (why: Initial story/choose_path dropoff is 23.8%, indicating users need immediate visual context on what the desktop pet does.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Wait Status Tip Carousel Notification: Enable ready notifications and embed an interactive tip carousel component during the desktop pet launch waiting screen. (why: Home step has a long median completion time (201s) and low overall completion (19.9% finish full onboarding).)
6: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Account Protection Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing account backup and pet safety. (why: 8 users wrote to support regarding lost or reset pets post-sign-in, and 2 reported sign-in screen stalls.)
